issues_to_confirm_with_owner: AUDIENCE: Who is the chatbot for: clients booking lash appointments, lash techs buying the adhesive, or both? Questions are tagged by audience so scores can be split.

PERMISSION: get Jane's okay to use her site and booking-page content in the pilot, and to share her contact details through the bot. Ask for the policies as plain text too (they are images on the booking page).
AFTERCARE: she stresses keeping lashes clean (oil breaks down glue) and has no formal document. Anything else the bot should say (washing, sleeping, lifespan)? The bot is told not to add more.
ALLERGIES: no formal patch test; she asks first-timers about glue allergies. What should the bot say to someone with sensitive eyes or an eye condition?
CANCELLATION: 24 hours' notice is ideal and the deposit is non-refundable either way. What happens to the deposit if Jane cancels?
FILLS: the bot has no definition of 'Foreign Fill-in' beyond the top-view photo rule. What happens if a client has less than 40% of lashes on, and is there a late-fill surcharge?
MONDAY SALE: covers any full set, not add-ons or fills. Are add-ons priced normally when added to a Monday Sale booking?
ADD-ONS: Cat-Eye, Doll-Eye and Silent Appointment are free. Do they add time? What is a Silent Appointment? Do add-ons differ by service?
CLASSIC SET: is there a classic set? The Wet Set is described as a classic look; confirm what to tell clients who ask for classic.
LOCATIONS: which days or services are in Example City vs Sample Town?
PAYMENT: the deposit is paid by card through Stripe at booking. Is the cash-only rule for the balance firm?
PICKUP (shop): address is behind 'View store information'; what may the bot share? Terms say she reaches out to arrange a time, the product page says usually ready in 1 hour. Which is true?
ADHESIVE: sold to anyone or only lash techs? Confirm wording on retention (6-8 weeks vs 'up to'), sensitive eyes, and safety. Product details and price are verified.
REFRESH: bookings open on the 20th each month, and prices or policies may change. Re-scrape or re-check monthly and date every knowledge base entry.
